build.buildCommand: echo 'Nixpacks plan handles install + build phases above'

DEBUG.description: Enable verbose debug logging (false in production)

PORT.description: HTTP listen port (assigned automatically by Railway)

DATABASE_URL.description: SQLAlchemy database URL. Automatically injected when you add the Postgres plugin. SQLite fallback is ephemeral (data lost on restart).

JWT_SECRET.description: REQUIRED: HS256 signing key for JWT sessions. Generate: python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(64))'

ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES.description: JWT access token TTL in minutes (default: 24 hours)

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed browser origins. Use * to allow any origin (convenient for Railway's dynamic domain but less restrictive).

RG_AI_DISABLE.description: Disable Groq/OpenAI Copilot features so the app boots without AI keys. Set to false and add GROQ_API_KEY to re-enable.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional: Groq (or OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible) API key for the AI Copilot rewriter. Also set RG_AI_DISABLE=false.

GROQ_BASE_URL.description: Optional: Override base URL for LLM API provider (Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.)

RELEASEGRAPH_WORKSPACE.description: Optional: Default workspace path scanned on first boot for demo projects.
